critique.evidence: Reduced-motion handling is correctly proven at all three viewports: the media query matches and the hero remains at opacity 1 with no transform. Tablet and mobile timing is near 60 fps (16.87–17.28 ms average, no long frames), but desktop averages 22.36 ms with a 50 ms worst frame. More importantly, the measured midpoint is effectively identical to the endpoint across every viewport—opacity about 0.45 with the same near-final 3D transform and -30 px translation—while the start is opacity 1/transform none. This does not demonstrate smooth interpolation and suggests an abrupt or excessively front-loaded transition.
critique.fix: Retune the animation so measured quarter-, midpoint-, and three-quarter frames show clear progressive interpolation in opacity and transform rather than reaching the final state by midpoint. Reduce the expensive 3D transform if necessary, target a desktop average near 16.7 ms with a lower worst frame, and retain the verified reduced-motion override.
